A malformed data URI with extract_images enabled produces an ImageExtractionFailed warning

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"extract_images\":true}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>Text<img src=\"data:BADMIME\" alt=\"broken\">end</p>", options);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
